import heapq


def pass_route(
    n: int,
    edges: list[list[int]],
    stations: list[list[int]],
    prices: list[int],
) -> int:
    adj: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]] = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        adj[u].append((v, cost, zone))
        adj[v].append((u, cost, zone))

    station_mask = [0] * n
    for stop, z in stations:
        station_mask[stop] |= 1 << z

    num_zones = len(prices)
    num_masks = 1 << num_zones
    INF = 10**18
    dist = [[INF] * num_masks for _ in range(n)]
    dist[0][0] = 0

    pq: list[tuple[int, int, int]] = [(0, 0, 0)]

    while pq:
        d, u, mask = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if d > dist[u][mask]:
            continue
        if u == n - 1:
            return d

        avail = station_mask[u] & ~mask
        while avail:
            lsb = avail & -avail
            z = lsb.bit_length() - 1
            nmask = mask | lsb
            nd = d + prices[z]
            if nd < dist[u][nmask]:
                dist[u][nmask] = nd
                heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, u, nmask))
            avail ^= lsb

        for v, cost, zone in adj[u]:
            w = 0 if (zone != -1 and (mask & (1 << zone))) else cost
            nd = d + w
            if nd < dist[v][mask]:
                dist[v][mask] = nd
                heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v, mask))

    return -1
